---
title: "Risk rating summary (Output 7)"
guide-section: "User Guide"
---

Output 7 assembles debt-carrying capacity, thresholds, mechanical ratings,
and moderate-risk granularity into the risk summary. Edit CI Summary, Input
6/7, Macro, and Ext in Excel before computing it.

> Excel → Chart Data mechanical ratings → risk summary → Output 7

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.run import SHEET_7, compute_outputs

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
output = compute_outputs(workbook, include=[SHEET_7])
risk_summary = output.sheets[SHEET_7]
```

The expanded API builds the same panel with `RiskRatingSummary` and
`risk_summary_panel`. Mechanical external, fiscal, and overall ratings come
from registered baseline and stress paths. Final ratings initially follow the
mechanical result until judgement is explicitly applied.

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| Debt-carrying capacity and thresholds | CI Summary |
| Mechanical external and public ratings | Chart Data |
| Moderate granularity | Output 5-1 |
| Combined risk summary | Output 7 |

Output 7 is not the same as the exported `Output - Summary` metadata sheet.
The latter, together with `Output Database`, is included by the sidecar export
described in [Getting started](01-getting-started.qmd).

The complete worked example is
[`demo/output_7.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_7.ipynb).
